header.contentDescription: Two sine waves and their sum, with the phase between them draggable from in-step to opposed

drawTextAnchored.text: in step - the sum is twice either one
opposed - they cancel, and the energy went elsewhere
Cancellation does not destroy energy. Where two waves cancel, another place gets double -
which is why noise-cancelling headphones work at your ear and nowhere else in the room.
drag to slide one against the other
